cutscene.warriors.intro.title: Warriors
cutscene.warriors.intro.monologue.4: Ho... how did I get here?
cutscene.warriors.intro.dialogue.5: The edge of it. It isn't your time yet.
cutscene.warriors.intro.dialogue.7: You died. But before you can rest in StarClan, you must live as one of us.
cutscene.warriors.intro.dialogue.9: Where cats go when they pass. You were never meant to be a twoleg.
cutscene.warriors.intro.dialogue.10: So I was never meant to be human?
cutscene.warriors.intro.dialogue.13: You will be reborn. But first, you must make some choices.
warriors.rebirth.title: Rebirth
warriors.rebirth.subtitle: Every choice shapes the life ahead of you.
warriors.rebirth.mode.title: How will you live?
warriors.rebirth.mode.vanilla.name: Vanilla  [1]
warriors.rebirth.mode.vanilla.desc: Play the normal minecraft experience, but as a cat. Mobs spawn, you can mine at the average speed, and you can go beat the ender dragon. You'll keep your cat form and traits.
warriors.rebirth.mode.realistic.name: Realistic  [2]
warriors.rebirth.mode.realistic.desc: Play in the life of a warrior, be born, get a mentor, do patrols (quests), turn into a warrior, and then, maybe turn into a leader or deputy. Hostile or unrealistic mobs don't spawn here, you live until you die, with the option to skip some patrols and break the warrior code, or follow it and go to StarClan after death.
warriors.rebirth.line.realistic: I- I would like to be reborn as a normal cat, and live the life of a warrior.
warriors.rebirth.line.vanilla: I- I liked my old life a lot. And I would like to get something similar to that.
warriors.rebirth.line.final: I would like to be a %s cat with %s eyes.
warriors.rebirth.line.final_hetero: I would like to be a %s cat with one %s left eye, and one %s right eye.
warriors.rebirth.line.custom: I would like to choose how I'll look please.
warriors.rebirth.line.randomized: I would like to go natural. As I may be born. I don't really care.
warriors.rebirth.line.clan: I would like to be a %s cat.
warriors.rebirth.appearance.title: Appearances
warriors.rebirth.appearance.natural.name: Randomized  [1]
warriors.rebirth.appearance.natural.desc: Go natural, exactly as you may be born. Your parents decide your pelt and eyes, and you don't really care.
warriors.rebirth.appearance.realistic.de: Get randomized values depending on your parents, all of them realistic. Accessories must be obtained on the map here.
warriors.rebirth.appearance.custom.name: Customizable  [2]
warriors.rebirth.appearance.custom.desc: Choose your colours: pelt, left eye, right eye and sclera. Accessories are found in the world.
warriors.rebirth.appearance.stylized.des: A dark, clean, and modern cat style with preset colours.
warriors.rebirth.age.title: Ages
warriors.rebirth.age.hint: Pick an age to be born at.
warriors.age.kit.name: Kit  [1]
warriors.age.kit.desc: The bare minimum. You'll struggle to survive unless some other cat adopts you.
warriors.age.adolescent.name: Adolescent  [2]
warriors.age.adolescent.desc: You know how to hunt, can run decently fast and understand the world a bit more.
warriors.age.adult.name: Adult  [3]
warriors.age.adult.desc: The age of the warrior. Hunt and run at average cat speeds.
warriors.rebirth.name.title: Your Name
warriors.rebirth.name.hint: Type a prefix and a suffix, or leave a box empty to be given a random one.
warriors.rebirth.name.prefix: Prefix (a nature word, like Fern or Hawk)
warriors.rebirth.line.age: I would like to be born as %s.
warriors.rebirth.line.age_cat.kit: Tiny paws, tiny claws... stay close to someone kind, little one.
warriors.rebirth.line.age_cat.adolescent: Old enough to hunt, young enough to still learn. A good age.
warriors.rebirth.line.age_cat.adult: Then do not waste it, warrior.
warriors.rebirth.reborn: You were reborn with a new look.
warriors.scent.familiar: I've smelled this before... I'm starting to be sure it's %s.
warriors.scent.learned: I know this smell now. This is %s territory.
warriors.scent.home: The comforting scent of home fills your nose: %s territory.
warriors.scent.wild: The scents of many cats mingle here, but no clan has claimed this heart of the forest.
warriors.scent.unknown: That scent is strange to me... %s. %s, maybe?
warriors.scent.hint.forest: fresh leaves, flowers and plump prey
warriors.scent.hint.marsh: damp earth, spruce and something stale
warriors.scent.hint.mountain: cold stone, blossoms and thin air
warriors.terrain.forest.desc: Wooded hills where prey runs thick.
warriors.terrain.lake.desc: A forest island ringed by a lake.
warriors.terrain.marsh.desc: Dark, boggy woods dotted with pools.
warriors.terrain.moor.desc: Wide open moorland beneath endless sky.
warriors.terrain.mountain.desc: A green mountain crowned with cherry trees.
warriors.terrain.town.desc: A quiet village of twolegs and soft beds.
warriors.terrain.scrub.desc: Scrappy hills and rough ground to roam.
warriors.terrain.desert.desc: Rolling dunes under a burning sun.
warriors.terrain.tundra.desc: Cold, windswept hills dusted with snow.
warriors.clans.title: Customize Clans
warriors.clans.hint: Shape the clanlands before they are born.
warriors.clans.locked: The clans can't be changed right now: the land already exists, or you are not the world's owner.
warriors.clans.name: Name
warriors.rebirth.clan.title: Clans
warriors.rebirth.clan.hint: Each clan lives in its own corner of the valley.
warriors.clan.thunderclan.desc: An open flower forest, warm and gentle.
warriors.clan.riverclan.desc: A forest island ringed by rivers.
warriors.clan.shadowclan.desc: Tall, dark spruce woods full of secrets.
warriors.clan.windclan.desc: Wide open plains beneath endless sky.
warriors.clan.skyclan.desc: A green mountain crowned with cherry trees.
warriors.clan.kittypet.desc: A soft bed and a quiet village to call home.
warriors.clan.stray.desc: No home, but the whole valley to roam.
warriors.clan.rogue.desc: A loner's path, far from any clan.
warriors.rebirth.customize.title: Your new self
warriors.rebirth.missing_dimension: The clanlands could not be loaded. You remain in the old world.
